claim: A standing jump (normalJumpZ -0xbaaaa against kDudeGravity 58,254) rises about 15,370 z, 0.91 of a standing body, so with the walking step on top a player gets out of a pit or onto a ledge of roughly 20,000 z and no more. For the other direction: fall damage is mulscale30(zvel, zvel) - kFallDamageFloor (1,600) at the landing, so the last painless drop is 62,564 z (3.69 bodies), 68,025 (4.01) is the first that hurts and 127,411 (7.51) kills from full health.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.h:185-187 (kDudeGravity, kDudeAirborneHeight, kFallDamageFloor); player.cpp:134 normalJumpZ; actor.cpp:4595-4631 (integration) and :4835-4847 (landing damage).
bloodmap.layers.fall_cost runs the same integrator; in a bot run AGTST3 climbed an 11,264 rise by jumping and refused a 21,504 one (2026-08-27).

2026-11-26: stepping MoveDude's order (z += zvel>>8, then z += (2*kDudeGravity)>>8 and zvel += kDudeGravity, actor.cpp:4596-4631) from zvel -0xbaaaa gives an apex of 15,367; the continuous v*v/2g is 19,600, which ignores the per-tick gravity displacement. bloodmap/supplies.py:40 and :72 quote 19,600 as the apex; bloodmap.player_space has no jump height (jump is a flag)
use: A drop entry under ~3.7 bodies never hurts; a mouth or ledge under jump plus step (about 20,000 z) can be climbed back out, which is the test for 'this pit is not a trap'.
